The '''''Savage Pleasure''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|resort liner]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mael Sidras]], all aboard were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Among the dead were most of the [[Khzrry family unit]], a prominent [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]] family. The only surviving members of the family, [[K'lial Khzrry|K'lial]] and [[Diskio Khzrry]], vowed to help bring down the Empire in response, becoming agents of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].
